name: io.github.hcpapi/housecall-pro-mcp
description: Independent MCP server for the Housecall Pro API: jobs, estimates, invoices, price book, schedule.

environmentVariables.name: HCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Housecall Pro API key. Generated under My Apps, Go to App store, API Key Management. Requires their MAX plan and an admin login.

environmentVariables.name: HCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register no tool that can change anything in Housecall Pro.

environmentVariables.name: HCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated groups to register: company, customers, jobs, estimates, invoices, pricebook, schedule, reports, admin. Also 'all' and 'default'. Fewer tools in context makes a client choose better among them.
